response.rationale: The item is electronics delivered 20 days ago. The electronics-specific rule RET-003 (priority 20) controls over the standard 30-day window rules (priority 10). Since electronics returns are not accepted after 15 days and 20 > 15, the return is ineligible. Higher-priority rules do not apply: final_sale is false (RET-012), defective is not true (RET-020), and no goodwill grant or fraud hold is set.
